recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, candid studio photograph featuring a man in a puffer jacket and headphones looking down at a child, set against a dark recording booth background with layered, centered white typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical eye-line connection between the adult and child
Contrast between the reflective white jacket and the dark studio shadows
Textual layering over the central vertical axis of the composition
coreInvariants: Hard flash lighting with visible grain
Recording equipment (microphone, headphones) as environmental context

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Adult male dominates the right two-thirds; child positioned in the lower-left quadrant looking upward.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The reflective white puffer jacket serves as the primary light source and anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the adult's face, follows his gaze down to the child, then moves left to the typographic stack.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background and recording booth provide high-contrast negative space for white text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm wood tones and skin tones
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value contrast; heavy film grain texture throughout.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses ultra-condensed, heavy-weight gothic capitals
Secondary text uses wide-tracked, small-cap sans-serif
Tertiary text uses a thin, fluid, monolinear signature script
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script flourishes extend horizontally to frame the composition width
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, industrial sans-serif and personal, fluid handwriting.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the ultra-condensed, heavy-weight display feel.
Captures the personal, handwritten quality of the lower text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a candid photo of a man in a black and white puffer jacket wearing headphones in a dark recording studio, looking down at a young boy who is looking up at him. Use hard flash lighting and heavy film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a three-tier typographic stack on the left side. Top tier: bold condensed uppercase sans-serif. Middle tier: small-cap wide-tracked sans-serif. Bottom tier: thin, fluid white script that spans the width of the other two tiers.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear vertical hierarchy?
Does the script look like a natural signature?
Is the film grain visible across the whole image?

postGenerationChecks: Check for eye-line alignment between subjects
Verify text legibility against the dark background
Ensure the puffer jacket texture is preserved
Confirm the script does not obscure vital facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Hard Flash + Condensed Sans/Script Pairing
